SELECT AI.*, (SELECT M.MODEL_TYPE FROM AI_MODEL M WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) LIMIT 1) AS model_type, ( SELECT SE.AVATAR FROM AI_MODEL M JOIN SYS_EXTENSION SE ON (SE.DELETED = 0 OR SE.DELETED IS NULL) AND (SE.EXTENSION_CODE = M.EXTENSION_CODE OR SE.EXTENSION_KEY = M.EXTENSION_CODE) WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) AND M.EXTENSION_CODE IS NOT NULL AND M.EXTENSION_CODE != '' ORDER BY CASE WHEN SE.EXTENSION_CODE = M.EXTENSION_CODE THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1 ) AS providerAvatar, ( SELECT AA.ACCOUNT_NAME FROM AI_ACCOUNT AA WHERE AA.ACCOUNT_KEY = AI.ACCOUNT_KEY AND (AA.DELETED = 0 OR AA.DELETED IS NULL) LIMIT 1 ) AS account_name, ( SELECT M.CAPABILITIES FROM AI_MODEL M WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) LIMIT 1 ) AS capabilities FROM `AI_INSTANCE` AI WHERE (AI.DELETED = 0 OR AI.DELETED IS NULL)
AND AI.INSTANCE_KEY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.instanceKey}, '%')
AND AI.INSTANCE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.instanceName}, '%')
AND AI.MODEL_KEY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.modelKey}, '%')
AND AI.STATUS = #{req.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AI_MODEL M WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE AND M.MODEL_TYPE = #{req.modelType} AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AI_MODEL M WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE AND M.EXTENSION_CODE = #{req.extensionCode} AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) )
AND AI.BIZ_KEY = #{req.bizKey}
ORDER BY AI.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT AI.*, (SELECT M.MODEL_TYPE FROM AI_MODEL M WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) LIMIT 1) AS model_type, ( SELECT SE.AVATAR FROM AI_MODEL M JOIN SYS_EXTENSION SE ON (SE.DELETED = 0 OR SE.DELETED IS NULL) AND (SE.EXTENSION_CODE = M.EXTENSION_CODE OR SE.EXTENSION_KEY = M.EXTENSION_CODE) WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) AND M.EXTENSION_CODE IS NOT NULL AND M.EXTENSION_CODE != '' ORDER BY CASE WHEN SE.EXTENSION_CODE = M.EXTENSION_CODE THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1 ) AS providerAvatar FROM `AI_INSTANCE` AI WHERE (AI.DELETED = 0 OR AI.DELETED IS NULL) AND AI.BIZ_KEY = #{bizKey} ORDER BY AI.CREATE_TIME ASC

SELECT AI.*, (SELECT M.MODEL_TYPE FROM AI_MODEL M WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND (M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE OR (M.ENV_CODE IS NULL AND AI.ENV_CODE IS NULL)) AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) LIMIT 1 ) AS model_type, ( SELECT SE.AVATAR FROM AI_MODEL M JOIN SYS_EXTENSION SE ON (SE.DELETED = 0 OR SE.DELETED IS NULL) AND (SE.EXTENSION_CODE = M.EXTENSION_CODE OR SE.EXTENSION_KEY = M.EXTENSION_CODE) WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND (M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE OR (M.ENV_CODE IS NULL AND AI.ENV_CODE IS NULL)) AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) AND M.EXTENSION_CODE IS NOT NULL AND M.EXTENSION_CODE != '' ORDER BY (CASE WHEN SE.EXTENSION_CODE = M.EXTENSION_CODE THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) LIMIT 1 ) AS providerAvatar, ( SELECT AA.ACCOUNT_NAME FROM AI_ACCOUNT AA WHERE AA.ACCOUNT_KEY = AI.ACCOUNT_KEY AND (AA.DELETED = 0 OR AA.DELETED IS NULL) LIMIT 1 ) AS account_name, ( SELECT M.CAPABILITIES FROM AI_MODEL M WHERE M.MODEL_KEY = AI.MODEL_KEY AND (M.ENV_CODE = AI.ENV_CODE OR (M.ENV_CODE IS NULL AND AI.ENV_CODE IS NULL)) AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) LIMIT 1 ) AS capabilities FROM AI_INSTANCE AI WHERE AI.ID = #{id} AND (AI.DELETED = 0 OR AI.DELETED IS NULL)
SELECT DISTINCT MODEL_KEY FROM AI_INSTANCE WHERE ENV_CODE = #{envCode} AND (DELETED = 0 OR DELETED IS NULL)
